method: Looked at the rectified strip photo above the orthographic render of the LIVE GLB at the same scale (scripts/street-surveys/build.ts --review-out). Held faces: the staged compile. Standalone/x2: pand-reference front crop vs orthographic front of the drawn GLB.

bilder-081118-155417: Overall rhythm, storey lines, shops and signs match; the stepped gables of 124/128 and 126 read right (the per-house 156287 model's lopsided gable is NOT what the game draws).
Dark 3DBAG roof wedges show beside the gables of 128 and 126 from the front.
bilder-164451-156126: Storeys, shops (Beter Horen, Pagode) and the stepped gables match.
The double house 76–78 has two identical curved gablets in the photo; the model gives one bell gable and one pointed dormer.
bilder-166802-235892: The orange pair (88–90) has two ornate tower gables at its outer bays; the model draws them as thin pointed shafts, much narrower than the photo, and omits the two white dormers between them.
84–86 windows have segmental arched heads in the photo; the model's are flat rectangles.
bilder-236189-166159: 102–106: the photo has two stepped gables, arched window heads and balcony axes; the model has a plain 8-axis wall with three dormers, equal flat windows and one continuous ground-floor glazing with the SUNIKA sign squeezed into the corner (crownGroups/split fronts not adopted yet — TODO).
A brick 3DBAG roof mass rises above the skyline at the far left.
bilder-161259-236206: 114 (160212): the photo's pointed gable is narrow (about a third of the front); the model's triangle spans the whole front with a dark roof slab standing above it.
116 (157154): a stray brick block sticks up at the left of the stepped gable.
108–110: the tall pointed gable at the right end is missing (only a dark roof spike); the second striped awning and shop window are not modelled.
Segmental arched window heads (photo) are flat in the model on 108–116.
bilder-233645-236975: The photo's low curved (bell-shouldered) gables contain the arched top-storey windows; the model puts the arched windows below a cornice and adds three blank brick blocks with shallow triangular tops above it.
bilder-080336-090492: The flat roof with its white overhanging eave reads in the model as a ~2 m dark slate band (3DBAG roof mass) above the cornice.
Middle-bay windows are narrower than the photo's broad three-light windows; the oriels at both ends are drawn flat (acceptable at this LOD).
bilder-233580-162444: 156–162 corner block: the photo's bricked-up (blind) windows on the left are drawn glazed; segmental window heads drawn flat.

158–162 (162443) is a different building in the photo (darker brick, stone bands, end pilasters rising above the cornice with their own windows); the model continues the corner block's cornice and plain wall across it.
bilder-161281-157756: Held (tree). Also wrong if installed: 113 has four window storeys above the ground floor in the photo, the model three; the dense white stone banding is reduced to two bands; 113's left bay of blind windows is drawn as plain wall without the blind frames.
bilder-157757-164549: Held (eaves). 133's cornice sits a storey higher than 131's in the model while the photo has them nearly level; the stone-framed pointed dormer on a pantile roof is a small floating dormer.
